components.name: Accordion
components.description: Collapsible content sections with ARIA accordion semantics and keyboard navigation

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline alert for status messages with semantic variants (destructive, success, warning, info)

components.name: AppShell
components.description: Application frame with a sectioned sidebar, sticky header and scrolling main; the sidebar becomes a left Drawer on small screens.

components.name: Attachment / AttachmentList
components.description: File chips for prompts and messages. `Attachment` renders one file; `AttachmentList` renders a wrapping row. Display-only: upload and file-system logic stay in the consumer.

components.name: AuthLayout
components.description: Centered authentication surface: brand, title/description, form card and footer, with size presets.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Free-text type-ahead input with a portalled listbox: static or async options, grouped headings, descriptions and custom rows.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A user profile image component with fallback support and accessible image loading

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small status indicator component for displaying tags, counts, or status information

components.name: Block
components.description: Semantic container (div by default, swappable element) — the structural counterpart to Text (p).

components.name: Branch
components.description: Variant navigation for branched messages: previous/next arrows with an N/M position indicator.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Navigation breadcrumb trail with links and current-page indicator

components.name: Button
components.description: A clickable button component with variants for different visual styles and sizes

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: Joins buttons into one segmented control: adjacent borders collapse, middle corners square off, and only the outer corners stay rounded — a single outline around the group.

components.name: Card
components.description: A content container with header, body, and footer sections for grouping related information

components.name: ChainThought
components.description: Displays ordered reasoning steps with status indicators.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A native checkbox input styled to match the design system, plus CheckboxGroup for grouping related options under an accessible legend

components.name: CodeBlock
components.description: Syntax-highlighted code block with language label and copy-to-clipboard button.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.description: Cmd+K style command palette with lexical search, sectioned results and full keyboard navigation

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description: Accessible confirmation dialog with async pending state, destructive variant and cancellable actions, built on Dialog.

components.name: Confirmation
components.description: Human-in-the-loop approval gate for agent actions. Pauses execution until the user approves or rejects.

components.name: Conversation
components.description: A container for displaying a list of chat messages with auto-scroll and loading states

components.name: DataTable
components.description: Config-driven table: one component plus a columns config that owns shape, sorting, pagination, and row interaction.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Native date field with an ISO-string contract, min/max passthrough and an optional clear button.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Accessible modal dialog with focus trap/restore, backdrop and Escape dismissal, size presets, optional header/footer slots, a scrollable body, and opt-in fade motion.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Edge sheet for secondary flows: slides from any side (sm/md/lg), with Dialog-grade modal semantics (portal, focus trap, Escape, focus restoration).

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Placeholder for empty collections, zero-result searches and unconfigured features, with title, description and action slots.

components.name: Fieldset
components.description: Groups related form controls in a native fieldset with a legend, optional description, and an error slot.

components.name: FileUpload
components.description: Drag-and-drop file picker with a removable file list and per-file progress bars.

components.name: FilterBar
components.description: List-page filter strip: search field, filter controls, reset affordance and trailing actions.

components.name: Flex / FlexItem
components.description: Typed flexbox container (direction/align/justify/wrap/gap) with FlexItem for per-child grow/shrink/basis controls.

components.name: Form
components.description: Semantic form element with even-spacing layouts: stacked (default), bordered card, or inline row — native submit and validation untouched.

components.name: FormField
components.description: Label + control + hint/error in one unit with htmlFor, aria-describedby, and aria-invalid wiring applied automatically.

components.name: FormLayout
components.description: Groups form fields with even, tokenized spacing: vertical stack, horizontal row, or 1-4 column grid, optionally as a semantic fieldset.

components.name: Grid / GridItem
components.description: Typed CSS grid with column counts per breakpoint (literal utilities that survive purging), auto-fit min-column mode, and GridItem spans.

components.name: Heading
components.description: Semantic heading (h1-h6) with a safe default scale and an optional visual-size override.

components.name: InlineCitation
components.description: Perplexity-style inline citation chip that reveals the source title and snippet on hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: Input
components.description: A text input field with support for various input types and standard HTML input attributes

components.name: InputGroup
components.description: Composite input shell with flush left/right addons (icons, units, buttons) behind one outer outline; the nested field sheds its own border so the group reads as a single control.

components.name: Label
components.description: An accessible form label that associates with its control

components.name: Link
components.description: Inline link primitive with default/muted/underline/arrow/external variants, asChild router support and safe external handling.

components.name: List / ListItem
components.description: Semantic list (ul/li) for rows of related items: settings, results, nav — with leading/trailing slots, selection, and pressable rows.

components.name: Menu
components.description: Dropdown menu with keyboard navigation, typeahead, and ARIA menu semantics

components.name: Message
components.description: A chat message component that displays messages from users, assistants, or system prompts with optional avatars

components.name: MessageActions
components.description: Feedback toolbar for an AI response: copy to clipboard, thumbs up/down rating, and regenerate. Every action is a callback; the component holds no conversation state.

components.name: MetricCard
components.description: KPI tile: label, value, directional delta (arrow + color) and supporting hint.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: Standard page heading: optional breadcrumbs, level-1 title, description, right-aligned actions and a sub-row slot.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Numeric pagination with prev/next and boundary jumps; accepts page/pageCount or currentPage/totalPages and derives the count (plus a Showing X-Y of Z summary) from total/pageSize.

components.name: PasswordInput
components.description: Password field with an accessible show/hide toggle (aria-pressed), built on Input.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger with interactive content, closing on outside click and Escape

components.name: Progress
components.description: A determinate progress bar with role=progressbar and exact value semantics

components.name: PromptInput
components.description: A textarea input for entering chat prompts with auto-resize, keyboard shortcuts, and send button

components.name: Prose
components.description: Self-contained long-form typography for rendered markdown/MDX: headings, links, lists, code, tables, quotes and figures.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Native radio buttons grouped for mutually exclusive choices, with an accessible fieldset/legend wrapper

components.name: Reasoning
components.description: A collapsible component for displaying AI reasoning steps and chain-of-thought processes

components.name: Response
components.description: Streaming-optimized markdown renderer for AI responses with GFM support, streaming-safe repair of incomplete syntax, and highlighted code blocks with copy.

components.name: Search
components.description: Select-with-search: type to filter a full-width dropdown of options, or arrow through the full set from an empty query.

components.name: SectionHeading
components.description: Section heading block: eyebrow, title (level 2-4), description and actions, with left/center alignment and three sizes.

components.name: Select
components.description: Accessible select built on the native <select> with flat options, optgroups, a placeholder row and native multi-select.

components.name: SelectMenu
components.description: Custom listbox select for rich options: descriptions, icons, groups, multi-select, custom rows and hidden inputs for forms.

components.name: Separator
components.description: A visual divider between content blocks, decorative or semantic

components.name: SiteFooter
components.description: Marketing footer: brand + tagline column, link columns and a legal bar; router-agnostic via linkComponent.

components.name: SiteHeader
components.description: Marketing/site header: sticky bar with brand, horizontal navigation with prefix-aware active states, right-aligned actions and a mobile drawer.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: A loading placeholder that mirrors the shape of upcoming content

components.name: Source / Sources
components.description: Displays citations and references for an AI response. `Source` renders a single citation; `Sources` renders a numbered list with an overflow count.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Indeterminate loading indicator with accessible status semantics.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Multi-step flow indicator: ordered list, aria-current step, text state for complete/current/upcoming.

components.name: StreamingIndicator
components.description: Shows that an AI response is currently streaming.

components.name: Suggestions
components.description: Displays clickable follow-up prompts for AI interactions.

components.name: Switch
components.description: A toggle switch for binary settings, with role=switch and aria-checked

components.name: Table
components.description: Semantic data table with headers, body, footer, and accessible caption

components.name: TableCard
components.description: Table shell with title/description, header actions, optional toolbar, edge-to-edge body and a footer row.

components.name: TableOfContents
components.description: Sticky 'On this page' navigation with nested levels and aria-current, plus a useScrollSpy hook for the active heading.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tabbed content container with ARIA tablist semantics and keyboard navigation

components.name: Text
components.description: Semantic paragraph text with a controlled type scale; renders a real p (or span with inline).

components.name: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text input styled to match Input, wrapping the native textarea

components.name: TimePicker
components.description: Native time field with an HH:MM contract and an optional clear button.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Vertical chronology for experience, activity and audit trails, built on an ordered list.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Accessible notifications: tree-scoped provider/hook plus an imperative toast() API rendered by <Toaster />.

components.name: ToolCall
components.description: A component for displaying AI tool/function calls with status, arguments, and results

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Hover/focus tooltip with aria-describedby association, delay, and Escape dismissal
